Opening on macOS the first time

The app is signed but not yet notarized by Apple. If macOS blocks the first launch, open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway at the bottom.

If Windows says it protected your PC

SmartScreen may stop less common installers. Click More info → Run anyway.

Linux

Make the AppImage executable (chmod +x) and run it. Install the deb with sudo apt install ./file-name.

After installing

  1. Open Nomi and finish the three-step onboarding.
  2. Connect the coding agents you already use, or install them during onboarding.
  3. Start your first task on the board.
